d0_diagnosis.hypothesis: Sleep rows stored in the same time.time() tick share a timestamp. MemoryService.recent() orders only by time DESC, so their order is unspecified. _load_prior_candidates reads the newest 4,000 sleep rows and structure_edges keeps the first snapshot per candidate id. A different tie order keeps a different snapshot, which moves the readout by up to the observed 0.0044 nats.

organica/memory.py:390 — recent() orders by time DESC and has no rowid tiebreak.
organica/memory.py:465-477 — prune_sleep_candidates() already uses rowid DESC as a tiebreak, so the omission is specific to recent().
